Unfiled cursor-root range bug from potential-bugs.md. Rejects non-rooted state starts when the cursor root is outside the byte or point range; preserves sibling matches spanning a range.

Unfiled hidden-repetition pruning bug from potential-bugs.md. Includes wildcard starts in non-local pattern analysis while excluding completed alternatives. Covers intersecting and containing byte/point ranges, concrete controls, and the original nested-array reproduction.

Confirmed query-analysis bug from section 5 of potential-bugs.md. Clears inherited guarantee flags beneath wildcard parents so capture iteration cannot emit captures for impossible matches. Covers anchors, fields, nested wildcards, concrete controls, positive matches, and valid guarantees within concrete descendants.

Confirmed Rust pretty-printing bug from section 6 of potential-bugs.md. Preserves closing parentheses after quoted missing tokens and reads whitespace and parentheses only outside quoted tokens. Covers MISSING and UNEXPECTED tokens, raw quote characters and backslashes, fields, Node Display, and indentation.

Nullable-root report removed from potential-bugs.md. Preserves existing visible-tree empty-root enumeration when ranges would otherwise prune hidden repetitions. Covers optional and zero-or-more roots, byte and point ranges, identical visible trees from fixed and repeated grammars, and nonnullable captured controls.

Confirmed containing-range bug from the report originally numbered 8, now section 7 of potential-bugs.md. Restores visible depth and visibility after ascending from a skipped hidden subtree, so ancestor exits finish deferred matches. Covers byte and point ranges, adjacent-range controls, multiline input, ordinary leaf queries, and successful optional-child matches.

Confirmed cursor bug from section 7 of potential-bugs.md. Preserves entry descendant indices and subtracts the preceding subtree's visible size when traversing backward. Covers subsequent forward traversal and seeking descendant zero, nested and malformed JSON, hidden wrappers, aliases, extras, and every visible subtree origin. Includes the structural-index adjustment shared with previous-sibling-alias-after-extra.

Confirmed lexer bug from section 8 of potential-bugs.md. Assembles incomplete UTF-8 characters in a four-byte lexer buffer across successive callback offsets. Covers two-, three-, and four-byte characters, chunks of one through four bytes, callback points, owned buffer replacement, invalid UTF-8, and truncated EOF. UTF-16 and custom decoder behavior are unchanged.

Confirmed cancellation bug from section 9 of potential-bugs.md. Returns immediately after a progress-callback stop even when unfinished matches block queued captures, preserving resumable execution. Deterministic regression stops at three callback checkpoints and compares resumed match IDs, capture indices, and full capture snapshots with uninterrupted execution.

Confirmed query-analysis bug from section 10 of potential-bugs.md. Initializes descendants of ERROR parents as fallible, sharing the conservative policy for wildcard parents. The JSON colon reproducer tests absent required children at root and nested scopes, matches and captures, guarantee flags, present and optional children, alternatives, childless ERROR controls, and valid guarantees within concrete descendants.

Extra parents must not inherit the next structural child's alias. The Python ERROR before an aliased block otherwise appears as a block to query execution, allowing wildcard-parent matches inside ERROR and adding empty optional-child matches.

Preserves later named siblings after nested hidden nodes exhaust byte-based child lookup. Tracks the public child index without allocating an iterator stack. Covers offsets after a named child inside nested hidden grammar rules and all byte offsets in malformed C trees; also fixes the two C# error-node bisim reproductions.

Containing ranges include zero-width nodes at either boundary. Retains touching ancestors so missing children remain reachable through hidden wrappers. Covers byte and point ranges, multiline C input, disabled captures, match and capture iteration, empty containing ranges, and intersecting-range boundary controls.

Documentation only: correct reset roots, point-based child lookup, non-local query patterns, predicate arguments, and the full match-limit range. Also fixes four broken rustdoc links and three private links, including raw query ownership and deletion guidance. The non-local description relates to the wildcard range-pruning fix. Generated C bindings updated; Rust docs pass with RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings', and formatting checked. Squatter's incorrect match-limit compatibility claim is corrected separately in 81fd1c64e.
